title.value: Which exchanges and wallets do you support?

paragraph.value: All major exchanges and wallets, most blockchains and the popular DeFi protocols. If something is missing, upload a CSV file and our team will map it for you.

title.value: Do I have to pay tax on crypto?

paragraph.value: In most countries, yes. Selling, swapping or spending crypto can create a capital gain, and staking or mining rewards usually count as income. We check the rules for you.

title.value: How long does a tax report take?

paragraph.value: Most reports are ready within 48 hours of importing your data. Complex DeFi activity or several years of history can take longer — we give you a date before we start.

title.value: Can you handle DeFi and NFTs?

paragraph.value: Yes. We classify lending, liquidity pools, bridges, airdrops, NFT mints and sales, and explain how each one is taxed in your country.

title.value: I didn’t report crypto in past years. What now?

paragraph.value: It happens more often than you think. We prepare amended returns for previous years and help you set the record straight before the tax office asks.
We prepare reports for the US, the UK, Germany and most EU countries. For other countries, our partner accountants can step in.

title.value: Is my data safe with you?

paragraph.value: We connect with read-only access, encrypt your data at rest and in transit and never share it with third parties without your consent.

title.value: How much do your services cost?

paragraph.value: Plans start at $12 per month. Complex cases get a fixed quote after a free review, so you know the price before any work begins.
